reuse.why: Every month-wide action, the new one included, uses the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selector, and the new action reuses averageToBudget, batchMessages and setBudget. The #fixed check, however, uses a private regex instead of the shared tag parsing in shared/tags (extractTagsFromText).

duplication.why: The exclusion rules are written once in the selector. The only overlap is a hand-rolled tag regex, with different case sensitivity, next to the shared tag helpers.

placement.why: Exclusion rules sit in the bulk-category selector in budget/actions.ts and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts. hasSavedTemplates parses goal_def locally, although goal-template.ts owns that format.

scope.why: Focused overall, but getBudgetData's SELECT gains c.goal_def, which nothing uses.

maintainability.why: A single selector decides which categories a month-wide action touches, and includeHiddenCategories replaces the old includeHidden cleanly. The ad-hoc tag regex and the unused column are small blemishes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts FIXED_TAG/hasFixedTag reimplement tag detection instead of using shared/tags (extractTagsFromText).

disguised_duplication.where: The tag regex is a fresh implementation, not a reshaped copy, and no selection logic is restated.

abstraction_drift.where: In getBulkBudgetCategories, includeHidden is replaced by includeHiddenCategories (passed through by every action), and one exclusion branch (saved templates or #fixed group) is added. Every month-wide action, the new setLastMonthSpending included, goes through it.
